description:
Synopsis - SPRDL1-26-R-0069
This posting is a synopsis, not an official RFP.
DLAWS (Warren) anticipates issuing a solicitation that will result in a Firm-Fixed Price contract for the following item:

Noun: Wheel, Solid Rubber Tire
NSN: 2530-00-701-3976
Part Number (P/N): 7013976
Total Quantity: 7,112 each (Base Qty 3,556 ea / Option Qty 3,556 ea)
Packaging: Military A
FOB: Origin (complete FS6245, FS7033, FS7202)

This solicitation is Full and Open Competition.

TDP/SPI: Technical Data and Special Packaging Instructions are available.
- This is a Qualified Product List (QPL) Item.

Please note: ONLY the Data Custodian, as identified in the United States/Canada Joint Certification Program (JCP) will be granted approval to download the Technical Data Package (TDP), once it is made available in Contract Opportunities –- No Exceptions.
If you are not JCP certified and would like to be, visit the link: 
https://www.dla.mil/HQ/LogisticsOperations/Services/JCP/ContactUs/

The solicitation should be released to the web on or about 15 days from this notification posting. Once available, the solicitation can be downloaded from SAM.gov (https://www.SAM.gov). See the solicitation for the actual closing date.
